reauth.title: Re-authenticate NomaIQ

init.title: AI device adoption
init.description: Devices NomaIQ doesn't natively support can be adopted: each one appears under Settings → System → Repairs, where you can run an AI Task to propose entities and review the result before anything is created. Nothing runs automatically.

data.offer_adoption: Offer AI adoption for unknown devices
data.enable_property_dump: Create diagnostic sensors for unmapped properties

data_description.ai_task_entity_id: Preferred AI Task entity for adopting unknown devices. Leave empty to pick one during each adoption.
data_description.offer_adoption: Creates a Repairs entry for each unknown device model so you can adopt it on demand.
data_description.enable_property_dump: One read-only diagnostic sensor per device property not covered by a mapping.
data_description.force_llm_models: Comma-separated oem_model_numbers (e.g. water-controller) routed through the adoption path even though they are natively supported. Their native entities become unavailable while forced.

failed.title: Classification failed
failed.description:
The AI could not produce a usable mapping for {model}:

{error}

preview.title: Proposed entities for {model}

confirm.title: Adopt {model} with AI
confirm.description: NomaIQ found "{device_name}" (model `{model}`) which has no built-in support. It exposes {property_count} properties ({writable_count} writable). An AI Task can analyze them and propose Home Assistant entities — nothing is created until you review and apply the proposal.

data_description.ai_task_entity_id: No AI Task entity is configured in the NomaIQ options yet. Pick the one to use; it is saved to the options when you apply the proposal.

progress.classifying: Asking the AI to classify {model}. This can take a couple of minutes.

abort.discarded: Proposal discarded. The repair stays open so you can adopt this device later.
abort.entry_not_loaded: The NomaIQ integration is not currently loaded.
abort.device_missing: The device is no longer present on the account.
abort.no_backend: No AI Task entity was selected.
abort.classification_in_progress: A classification for this model is already running.

unadopt_device.name: Un-adopt device
unadopt_device.description: Delete the stored AI mapping for a model and reload the integration. The adoption offer reappears under Repairs.

oem_model.name: OEM model
oem_model.description: The oem_model_number whose mapping should be removed.
